steps: Go to https://cashgiraffe.com/ and download the free Cash Giraffe app (Android or iOS).
Open the app and pick games from the Discover section that match your interests.
Launch and play the games through the Cash Giraffe app itself — the app tracks active playtime and milestones to award gems (playing outside the app does not count).
Rotate games when your gem-per-minute rate drops on a title — the company's own guide says the rate is not fixed and declines the longer you play one game.
Use daily streaks and cashback offers to boost gems; complete in-game milestones for one-off gem bonuses.
When you have enough gems, redeem for PayPal cash or gift cards (Amazon, Starbucks, Target, etc.) — cashouts start at just $0.20.
